policy: Profiles state broad applicability, weakening conditions, and evidence gaps. Individual edge dossiers remain authoritative for relationship-specific scope.

applies_where: All regions; strongest amplification over Arctic land and high northern latitudes

Regions and seasons dominated by circulation variability

profile.temporal_context: Multi-decadal forced trend with seasonal, annual, and decadal variability.
